rules.expression:
starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/")
and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/translate")
and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/widget-")
and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/chat")
and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/voice")

((http.user_agent contains "GPTBot") or (http.user_agent contains "CCBot") or (http.user_agent contains "Bytespider") or (http.user_agent contains "ClaudeBot") or (http.user_agent contains "Google-Extended") or (http.user_agent contains "Applebot-Extended") or (http.user_agent contains "Amazonbot") or (http.user_agent contains "FacebookBot")) and http.request.uri.path ne "/robots.txt"
